breakdown.description: The pressure field is floating because no reference pressure is set. For an incompressible simulation to converge, pressure must be fixed at least at one point, typically the outlet, with a `fixedValue` condition. Setting all pressure boundaries to `zeroGradient` will lead to a solver failure.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly changed the outlet pressure boundary condition from 'zeroGradient' to 'fixedValue' with 'value uniform 0', which sets the reference pressure at the outlet to atmospheric (0 gauge). This matches the ground truth and resolves the floating pressure issue that would cause solver failure in an incompressible simulation.
